title: Low degree mass outside influential coordinates
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, a real threshold $\tau$, and a nonnegative integer $k$, this mass is the sum of $\widehat f(S)^2$ over all subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $k$ that are not contained in the set of coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least $\tau$.
